integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] Following <Picture 1>, a static shot frames a circle of jostling monkeys by a pool before a straight white waterfall in bright noon light, none daring to approach the curtain of water.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the camera cuts to <Picture 2>: a slow push in toward the young monkey who elbows through the crowd to the poolside, plants his feet, squares up and stares up at the hanging waterfall with bright eyes.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.000, the camera cuts to <Picture 3>: static shot, a fixed shot holds the young monkey bracing a branch against the ground, sucking in a breath, then kicking off the ground and leaping straight into the falling water before the watching monkeys.

overall_soundscape: A roaring waterfall that swallows all other noise; the jittery chattering of monkeys and soft scraping of claws on wet stone.

non_diegetic_music: Lively bamboo-flute and plucked-string ditty, brisk tempo, a springing sense of eagerness.
@[图片1] = 花果山水帘洞
@[图片2] = 孙悟空

integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] Following <Picture 1>, a static shot captures the white water swallowing the young monkey whole, spray bursting high as the monkeys on the bank all flinch back two steps.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the camera cuts to <Picture 2>: static shot, a fixed close-to-medium look at the young monkey who pokes out half a wet face from behind the water curtain and waves hard toward the bank, water dripping from his fur.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.000, the camera cuts to <Picture 3>: static shot, a static close-up on the wet young monkey as he shouts across the water at the top of his lungs, `` <d>[Chinese] 里面别有洞天，都进得来！</d>

overall_soundscape: A loud splash as he plunges in and spray bursts; a muffled shout from inside the waterfall and the excited stir of the monkeys on the bank.

non_diegetic_music: The light bamboo flute continues, drums building toward the single plunge.
@[图片1] = 花果山水帘洞
@[图片2] = 孙悟空

integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] Following <Picture 1>, static shot, a fixed medium shot watches the young monkey duck back behind the hanging water curtain after his shout, the veil of water falling closed as he vanishes.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the camera cuts to <Picture 2>: static shot, a wide fixed shot in which the leading wild monkey first bravely jumps down with a splash and the rest follow one after another, leaping into the water curtain in a chain of spray.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the camera cuts to <Picture 3>: a wide static shot holds the young monkey crossing the iron-slab bridge, jumping onto the great natural stone seat at the center of the cave, sitting cross-legged and surveying the whole cavern.

overall_soundscape: The waterfall hissing steadily and echoing inside the cave; monkeys splashing in one by one with soft thuds.

non_diegetic_music: Tentative plucked strings, pace slowing, a held breath as they enter the cave.

integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] Following <Picture 1>, static shot, a static close-up on the old monkey by the corner who smacks his lips ruefully and lets out the words slowly, `` <d>[Chinese] 不然呢，谁不是一眨眼就老了。</d>
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the camera cuts to <Picture 2>: static shot, a static close-up on the young monkey who blinks as if he has truly never thought of this question, head tilting slightly, `` <d>[Chinese] 老了会怎样？</d>
[Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the camera cuts to <Picture 3>: static shot, a static close-up on the old monkey who now speaks very slowly, dwelling word by word on the sickness and the buried earth that no one escapes, `` <d>[Chinese] 老了会病，病重了就得埋进土里，谁也躲不过。</d>
[Shot 4] At 00:12.000, the camera cuts to <Picture 4>: static shot, a static medium shot in which the young monkey's face darkens at the words, his neck stiffening as he falls quiet, eyes going blank.

overall_soundscape: Low water; the old monkey's voice sinking word by word; a stretch of heavy silence from the stone seat.

non_diegetic_music: The adagio sinks lower, heavy and desolate.

[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the camera cuts to <Picture 2>: static shot, At 00:04.000, a static close-up on the pale king replying flatly that no magic escapes the book <d>[Chinese] 法力再高，也躲不开生死簿上这一笔。</d>
[Shot 3] At 00:08.000, the camera cuts to <Picture 3>: static shot, At 00:08.000, a static close-up on the young monkey pinning the king with his eyes, pressing to know how many years remain <d>[Chinese] 你倒说说，我这寿数还剩几笔？</d>
[Shot 4] At 00:12.000, the camera cuts to <Picture 4>: static shot, At 00:12.000, a static medium shot sees the king turn the roster and set a finger on the monkey page, poised to write

overall_soundscape: Echoing drips, the young monkey's rising retorts, and the king's steady, unhurried replies.

non_diegetic_music: Strings tightening and loosening around a back-and-forth about the book of life and death.

质量门

  • ✓剧本节拍被恰好一次、按顺序、连续认领（分镜级）
  • ✓每段 0 < 总秒数 ≤ 15（一次生成的上限）
  • ✓每个分镜 2–8 秒——短剧的注意力节奏
  • ✓认领节拍的台词装得进分镜秒数
  • ✓每集总时长在剧本目标 ±15% 内
  • ✓单个分镜同框 ≤ 3 人，超了必须带拆解说明
  • ✓段号 E01-01 格式、按顺序连号
  • ✓景别中文词写进分镜图提示词
  • ✓运镜用 H3 官方词表，且出现在自己的 [Shot k] 段落里
  • ✓H3 首行对齐指令由分镜结构推导逐字对账，切点时刻逐个对
  • ✓认领节拍的台词逐字进 H3 提示词的 <d> 块
  • ✓H3 提示词语言与设定一致（promptLang=en，正文全英文、骨架 token 官方英文格式）
  • ✓分镜图提示词中文且非空
  • ✗视频提示词不含角色名（H3 正文与 Seedance 镜头正文；分镜图提示词直呼其名放行）E13-09#1 的 Seedance 镜头正文出现角色名「白骨精」；E15-07#2 的 Seedance 镜头正文出现角色名「红孩儿」；E15-18#1 的 Seedance 镜头正文出现角色名「牛魔王」；E15-18#2 的 Seedance 镜头正文出现角色名「红孩儿」；E16-11#2 的 Seedance 镜头正文出现角色名「红孩儿」；E16-11#3 的 Seedance 镜头正文出现角色名「牛魔王」；E17-12#2 的 Seedance 镜头正文出现角色名「阎王」；E17-16#1 的 Seedance 镜头正文出现角色名「阎王」；E18-10#1 的 Seedance 镜头正文出现角色名「唐僧」；E20-09#3 的 Seedance 镜头正文出现角色名「沙僧」；E20-18#1 的 Seedance 镜头正文出现角色名「孙悟空」；E22-11#3 的 Seedance 镜头正文出现角色名「沙僧」；E24-12#1 的 Seedance 镜头正文出现角色名「沙僧」；E24-12#2 的 Seedance 镜头正文出现角色名「白龙马」
  • ✓构图量化字段齐全（每段 blocking；每镜焦距／机位／构图／视线落点／焦点／稳定性）
  • ✓Seedance 镜头正文中文非空，不写时间、镜头编号、图片引用和协议符号
  • ✓场次／人物／道具对账剧本
  • ✓引用的配方存在、必备短语进了分镜图提示词、多格配方连排够格数未挂载配方卡库（--shots <卡片目录>），本门跳过（视为通过）

分镜由模型依据剧本切分：段 = 一次生成（≤15 秒），分镜 = 段内 2–5 秒的剪切，每个分镜一张关键帧图。对齐指令、切点时刻、台词、提示词纪律全部由脚本确定性对账。分镜图出图走 codex，环境与角色设定图当参考图。
